editionLabel: Stronghold Games / Edition Spielwiese English rules, 2018
firstPlayerRule: The most colorfully dressed player is the starting player.
clarifications: That player reveals a Word card; everyone then chooses a Color card simultaneously.
The player to the left of the starting player tells the first story, and the starting-player role moves clockwise after the round.
